Usage: gokart <command> [flags]

GoKart scaffolds focused Go command-line applications.

Quick start:

    gokart new demo --example
    cd demo && go run . greet --name World
    gokart add sqlite --dry-run
    gokart config show

Commands:
  new (create,init)      Create a new GoKart project (no project name on a
                         terminal starts an interactive wizard).
    [<project> ...]      Project name or path (e.g. my-app); also accepts the
                         preset form "<preset> <project>" (e.g. "cli my-app").
                         Run with no project on a terminal to start the
                         interactive wizard.

  add                    Add integrations to a managed structured project.
    <integration> ...    Integration: sqlite, postgres, ai, or redis.

  detach                 Remove GoKart runtime coupling from a structured
                         project.

  version                Print the version number.

  config                 Show gokart configuration.
    show                 Print where gokart stores data.

Flags:
  -h, --help       Show context-sensitive help.
      --version    Print version information and quit.

Run "gokart <command> --help" for more information on a command.
